cycle: Standard Assembly Time per Piece — filled in from the Part when picked, and can be changed for the day.
shift: Assembly Working Hours = Assembly End Time − Assembly Start Time
idealQty: Ideal Assembly Quantity = Assembly Working Hours × 3600 ÷ Standard Assembly Time per Piece — not rounded down, as on the sheet.
rejectedQty: Rejected QTY = TOTAL QTY − OK QTY, so OK + Rejected = TOTAL.
pctOk: % OK Quantity = OK Quantity ÷ (OK Quantity + Rejected Quantity)
unutilized: Unutilized Machine Time = (12 − (Shift Hours − Lunch ÷ 60)) ÷ 11, with Shift Hours and Lunch added up across every entry of this machine's date — so every entry of that machine/date shows the same figure. Shown as 0% when the result is below 0 and 100% when it is above 100.
totalStoppage: Total Idle Time (Min) = Lunch / Tea / Washroom + Other
effective: Ideal Assembly Time (In Hour) = TOTAL QTY × Standard Assembly Time per Piece ÷ 3600 — every piece assembled counts, rejected ones too.
unreported: Unreported Time (min) = Planned Operator Shift × 60 − Ideal Assembly Time × 60 − Time in Other Activity − Total Idle Time, for this entry (with Process Master's fixed shift: combined across the worker's whole date).
setupEff: Setup Efficiency = Effective Machine Run Time ÷ Machine Shift Time
oeeLosses: OEE considering losses = Effective Run Time ÷ (Available Hours − Total Downtime ÷ 60), combined across every entry of this machine's date.
oeeLunch: OEE not considering losses but lunch = Effective Run Time ÷ (Available Hours − Lunch ÷ 60), combined across every entry of this machine's date.
oeeLunchCot: OEE not considering losses but lunch and setup time = Effective Run Time ÷ (Available Hours − Lunch ÷ 60 − Setup Time ÷ 60), combined across every entry of this machine's date.
availability: Availability = Operating Time ÷ Planned Production Time, for this entry. Operating Time = Assembly Working Hours − Total Idle Time − Other Activity; Planned Production Time = Planned Operator Shift − Lunch / Tea. Above 100% (red) sends the entry to Admin review.
performance: Performance = Standard Assembly Time per Piece × TOTAL QTY ÷ Operating Time, for this entry — how fast the assembly went against the standard time. Above 100% (red) sends the entry to Admin review: usually a wrong time per piece, quantity or idle time.
quality: Quality = OK QTY ÷ TOTAL QTY, for this entry.
review: Admin review: an entry whose Availability, Performance, Quality or any of its OEE figures (the Productivity figures, on a worker sheet) is above 100% is held as Pending review until an Admin or Super Admin approves or rejects it. Editing the figures sends it back for review; hover for details.
idealQtyPerHour: Ideal Assembly Quantity/Hour = 3600 ÷ Standard Assembly Time per Piece
productivity: Productivity without considering Lunch, tea, etc. = Ideal Assembly Time ÷ (Planned Operator Shift − Other Activity ÷ 60), for this entry (with Process Master's fixed shift: combined across the worker's whole date).
productivityLunch: Productivity considering Lunch, tea, etc. = Ideal Assembly Time ÷ (Planned Operator Shift − Other Activity ÷ 60 − Lunch / Tea ÷ 60), for this entry (with Process Master's fixed shift: combined across the worker's whole date).
